tshe sgrub yang snying kun 'dus kyi brgyud 'debs ni/chos sku snang mtha' longs sku 'chi med lha/ /sprul sku pad 'byung mkhar chen bza' mtsho rgyal/ /

tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250tshe sgrub yang snying kun 'dus kyi brgyud 'debs ni/1$0000300 chos sku snang mtha' longs sku 'chi med lha// sprul sku pad 'byung mkhar chen bza' mtsho rgyal// lo chen bai ro zab gter chos kyi bdag /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// dus min 'chi ba'i 'gal rkyen kun zhi zhing*// rdo rje tshe dang g.yung drung lta bu'i lus// mi 'gyur rtag brtan chen por byin brlabs te// 'chi med mgon po'i go 'phang myur thob shog /

'gyur med rdo rjes so/// / 1$0000250༈ 'chi med yang snying kun 'dus kyi las bum sgrub thabs ni/1$0000300 hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛta hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ las bum nang du pad nyi'i steng*/ khro rgyal dbang chen he ru ka /rngam brjid 'bar ba khro bo'i chas// phyag gnyis be con zhags pa 'dzin// spyi gtsug rta skad phyogs bcur sgrog /'jigs byed 'jigs mdzad khro bo'i rgyal// che btsan 'bar ba'i sku ru gyur// gnas gsum 'bru gsum gnas pa las// 'od 'phros ye shes spyan drangs gyur// oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs nas/ shab+da 'i bar gyis mchod/ bstod par 'os pa thams cad la// zhes sogs kyis bstod/ bdag gi thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba thon/ gzungs thag la 'khril te bum pa'i nang gi lha'i thugs kar zhugs/ sku'i cha thams cad nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ oṃ hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛta h+ya gṝ wa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bzla/ mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mchod yon phul bas/ lha nyid chags pa chen pos 'od du zhu nas byang chub kyi sems su ro gcig tu gyur par bsam mo// zhes pa'ang rat+na bi dza yas so// //
